answer: Each identity is sealed to one hardware chip at registration and must sign an unbroken hourly heartbeat for 6 epochs before it can transact. A newcomer that cannot wait posts a 127-POA bond co-signed by an established sponsor staking the same sum; if either side farms duplicates, both bonds slash and the seat burns. Forging 4 identities costs 4 real chips plus the bonds, and the gale of quotes is published for re-verification while the wander window lets anyone challenge a stale quote; the vault of the heartbeat proves a live device.
